name: Yamagishi Fuuka
source:
Fuuka is a former member of SEES and both [url=/c51882]Mitsuru[/url] and [url=/c52188]Akihito's[/url] junior. She is a kind, friendly and compassionate girl who would do anything for her friends. During her high school times, she was extremely shy, timid and a bit of a pushover, but managed to overcome these attributes. She does not participate in battles directly, but instead uses her Persona to transmit information, analyze the enemies and so on from the sidelines. Despite her innocent appearance, Fuuka is skilled with computers and machines from watching her father handle electronics.

[Edited from [url=http://megamitensei.wikia.com/wiki/Fuuka_Yamagishi]Megami Tensei Wiki[/url]]

Her persona is [Url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Juno]Juno[/url], the Roman goddess of womanhood and the governor of the other gods.
